mail.footer:
If you were not expecting this email, you can ignore it and avoid following any links.

This is an automated message.
To contact the organizers, email {{contactEmail}}.

reminder.subject: See you at {{eventName}}!
reminder.heading: {{eventName}} is getting close
reminder.body:
Hi {{name}},

{{eventName}} starts on {{eventDate}}. See you at {{checkInTime}} for check-in.

Remember to bring your ticket: show the QR code in this email when you arrive, or save it to your wallet.

[Add to Apple Wallet]({{appleUrl}})

[Add to Google Wallet]({{googleUrl}})

Your ticket is also available in your profile:

[View my ticket]({{walletUrl}})

We’re looking forward to seeing you!
The {{eventName}} team

verify.subject: Confirm your email for hackOS
verify.body:
Hi {{name}},

You created a hackOS account with this address. Confirm it to continue with your application:

[Confirm email]({{verifyUrl}})

The link works for one hour. If it has expired, you can request a new one from hackOS.

reset.subject: Reset your hackOS password
reset.body:
Hi {{name}},

You can choose a new password here:

[Reset password]({{resetUrl}})

If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email. Your password hasn't changed.

accountRemovalPin.subject: Confirm your hackOS account removal
accountRemovalPin.body:
Hi {{name}},

Your security PIN for removing your hackOS account is:

{{pin}}

This PIN expires in {{expiresMinutes}} minutes. If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email.

invite.subject: Set up your hackOS account
invite.body:
Hi,

{{inviterName}} has enabled an account for you on hackOS, the management system for {{eventName}}.

Next steps

Follow this link to finish creating your account and complete your details:

[Set up my account]({{claimUrl}})

{{accountAccess}}
invite.role: When you finish creating your account, you will automatically receive the role: {{roleNames}}.
invite.roles: When you finish creating your account, you will automatically receive the roles: {{roleNames}}.
invite.enterprise: Your account will be linked to {{enterpriseName}}.

verifyReminder1.subject: Verify your email to use hackOS
verifyReminder1.body:
Hi {{name}},

You created a hackOS account with this address, but you haven't verified it yet. Until you do, you can't submit applications, view information or make decisions on the platform.

[Confirm email]({{verifyUrl}})

The link works for three days. If it has expired, you can request a new one from hackOS.

Didn't you create this account? You can delete it:

[Delete this account]({{deleteUrl}})

If the account has a password, you'll need to enter it to confirm.

verifyReminder2.subject: Reminder: your hackOS email is still unverified
verifyReminder2.body:
Hi {{name}},

We're writing again because your hackOS account still has an unverified email. Without verification you can't submit applications, view information or use the platform.

[Confirm email]({{verifyUrl}})

The link works for three days. If it has expired, you can request a new one from hackOS.

Didn't you create this account? You can delete it:

[Delete this account]({{deleteUrl}})

If the account has a password, you'll need to enter it to confirm.

verifyReminder3.subject: Last reminder: verify your hackOS email
verifyReminder3.body:
Hi {{name}},

This is the last reminder we'll send. Your hackOS account is still unverified, so you can't submit applications, view information or use the platform.

If you want to keep it, verify it now:

[Confirm email]({{verifyUrl}})

The link works for three days. If it has expired, you can request a new one from hackOS.

Didn't you create this account? You can delete it:

[Delete this account]({{deleteUrl}})

If the account has a password, you'll need to enter it to confirm.

invite.subject: You've been invited to join {{projectName}}
invite.body:
Hi,

{{inviterName}} invited you to join their project {{projectName}} on hackOS.

Open My Project to accept or decline the invite.

called.subject: Your team was called
called.body:
Hi {{name}},

Your team {{teamName}} was called for {{challengeName}}. Go to the door of room {{roomName}} and wait outside. Do not enter yet.

precall.subject: Get ready: we'll call you soon
precall.body:
Hi {{name}},

Your team {{teamName}} will be called soon for {{challengeName}}. Get ready, but do not go to the room yet. Approximate time: {{etaMinutes}} minutes.

enter.subject: Come on in
enter.body:
Hi {{name}},

Enter room {{roomName}} now. It is your team's turn for {{challengeName}}.

message.subject: Message about {{challengeName}}

enter.subject: Team entering {{roomName}}
enter.body: {{teamName}} was asked to enter room {{roomName}} for {{challengeName}}.

called.subject: Team called for {{roomName}}
called.body: {{teamName}} was called to wait at the door of room {{roomName}} for {{challengeName}}.

decision.subject: A decision on your application
decision.body:
Hi {{name}},

We’ve reviewed your application to {{applicationName}}.{{decisionDetails}}

accepted.subject: Your spot at {{eventName}} is waiting for you!
accepted.heading: We can’t wait to see you at {{eventName}}!
accepted.body:
Hi {{name}},

Congratulations! We’ve accepted your application for {{applicationName}} at {{eventName}}, and we’re excited to have you join us.

We’ve reserved a spot for you. All that’s left is to confirm you’re coming.{{decisionDetails}}

We can’t wait to meet you!
The {{eventName}} team

rejected.subject: About your application for {{applicationName}} at {{eventName}}
rejected.body:
Hi {{name}},

Unfortunately, your application for {{applicationName}} at {{eventName}} hasn’t been selected this time. We know this isn’t the news you were hoping for.

Thank you for your interest and for the time you put into your application. We hope to see you at a future edition.

Best wishes,
The organizing team

decision.confirmationDetails:
{{deadlineNotice}}

[Confirm my spot]({{confirmUrl}})

If it turns out you can’t make it, please let us know so someone else can take your spot:

[Decline my spot]({{declineUrl}})

If the deadline passes without your confirmation, the spot will be released automatically.

draftReminder1.subject: Your {{applicationName}} application is still a draft
draftReminder1.body:
Hi {{name}},

You started an application for {{applicationName}} at {{eventName}}, but you haven't submitted it yet. It's still a draft, so we can't review it.

[Finish my application]({{applicationUrl}})

The {{eventName}} team

draftReminder2.subject: Reminder: submit your {{applicationName}} application
draftReminder2.body:
Hi {{name}},

A reminder that your application for {{applicationName}} at {{eventName}} is still a draft.

If you don't submit it, we won't be able to evaluate it and you won't be able to take part in {{eventName}}.

[Submit my application]({{applicationUrl}})

The {{eventName}} team

draftReminder3.subject: Last reminder about your {{applicationName}} application
draftReminder3.body:
Hi {{name}},

This is the last time we'll write to you about this. Your application for {{applicationName}} at {{eventName}} is still a draft, and we won't evaluate drafts.

If you'd still like to take part, you can submit it whenever you're ready:

[Submit my application]({{applicationUrl}})

We won't send any more reminders.

The {{eventName}} team

precall.title: Get ready: we’ll call you soon
precall.body: Do not go to the room yet. We’ll call {{teamName}} for {{challengeName}} in about {{etaMinutes}} minutes.
